story.body: You came down on Twelfth Day already buttoned for the yard. Mistress Ansell had the loaf at a finger short and would not make a new measuring of it. You took three bites, left the threepence as a thing she is holding in her head, and refused her a plot. Alse asked about the rope and about boys who play queens. Gillis was already at the loom.

story.body: You ate the slice she had kept, with her standing over you, and you stopped. You did not carry a new scene upstairs.
